source: Independent hand audit of validation/m12/fixtures/csharp/*.cs against C# language semantics (Roslyn naming: records → class, record properties from positional params, fields → property, events → event, delegates → delegate, constructors → constructor, indexers → this). Base-list kind resolution: a base class, if present, is listed FIRST in C# (rest are interfaces); kinds confirmed in-file and cross-file via the project companion.
